svg.title: The Iowa Army detonation
svg.desc: Two perspectives with ten picks each. Differ Rank orders all twenty arguments by weighted impact. Exact ties use the earlier pick, then the permanent argument ID.
svg.text: Should the Army have detonated the unstable lead azide stockpile in Iowa?

g.title: Reduce the no-warning risk — Reduce the risk of a surprise blast.
g.text: Reduce the risk of a surprise blast.

g.title: Show why another day was unsafe — Publish the evidence for the deadline.
g.text: Publish the evidence for the deadline.

g.title: Avoid moving the stockpile — Keep the hazard at the site.
g.text: Keep the hazard at the site.

g.title: Examine earlier intervention — Ask why safer choices disappeared.
Use the better weather window — Wait for conditions that reduce risk.
g.text: Wait for conditions that reduce risk.

g.title: Review alternatives in public — Explain why other choices failed.
Prepare people before the event — Give nearby households advance notice.
Give communities earlier notice — Reach residents before plans change.
Coordinate agencies and responders — Put responders on the same plan.
g.text: Put responders on the same plan.

g.title: Explain what delay improved — Account for safeguards added during delay.
g.text: Account for safeguards added during delay.

g.title: Measure against a baseline — Compare post-event results with earlier samples.
Test what may have settled — Check soil, dust and water separately.
g.text: Check soil, dust and water separately.

g.title: Separate the two risks — Compare planned action with waiting.
Map gaps in the testing — Show what each measurement covers.
End the stockpile hazard — Verify the material was destroyed.
Plan for uneven disruption — Identify households bearing the cost.
Respect the early evidence — Treat early air readings as evidence.
g.text: Treat early air readings as evidence.

g.title: Keep state oversight through cleanup — Coordinate across state and county lines.
g.text: Coordinate across state and county lines.

g.title: Keep the follow-up commitment — Own any verified harm after the event.
g.text: Own any verified harm after the event.

g.title: Demand a public after-action review — Publish findings and who owns cleanup.
g.text: Publish findings and who owns cleanup.

svg.text: Differ Rank weighs magnitude (50%), reach (30%) and duration (20%).
